boot.what: lobby-bootstrap SEs (1000 draws of the 300 headline lobbies; arm differences on the same draws). Opponents: each arm in both seats against the other arms of ARMS. humans_actual: the humans' own final teams in the 300 lobbies (600 teams). Real_by_fallback: the Real arm replays each human action while it is legal and falls back to GD when the opponent arm has taken or banned it. Differences are [point, se].

ablation.what: support of each arm's final teams against a common opponent set, with the judge-free paired record (pp per covered player; lobby-bootstrap SE, no seed term, so tighter than P3_TOURNAMENT's seed-widened CIs), J and CONS win % of the arm, all against the same opponent(s). Support is on paper 1's corpus. Set A: both seats vs aMCTS-pp (every design-study row has only this opponent). Set B: both seats vs each of pMCTS-cur, GD, Real (arms that played all three); record and J are vs pMCTS-cur.

matched.what: support on time-matched human corpora (Storm League slot-table teams; outcome-free counts; no sealed build or id; the 300 headline games excluded). Floors: raw 25; 'eq' = 25 x N_matched / N_paper1 (the same rate per team as 25 on paper 1's corpus); 'hp5' = the 5th percentile of the matched corpus's own teams' leave-one-out min3 (paper 1's 25 is the p5 of its held-out humans). p1_thin = paper 1's triple counts binomially thinned to the matched corpus size (5 draws), at the eq floor: the like-for-like reference for corpus size (gap closed = 1 - gap on the matched corpus / gap on thinned paper 1, both at eq). hp5 is degenerate (0) on the small lobby-window corpus. Shares as fractions, SE = lobby bootstrap.

residual.what: real Storm League games in the judge window (2026-07-01..09-11; post-snapshot, not the sealed build, no sealed id), one row per team (two per game), SEs clustered by game. r = y - WP_pop (slot-table causal WP). P = the drafter's personal term: sig(b0 + b1 logit WP + b2 dS + b3 dO) - sig(b0 + b1 logit WP), dS/dO = team minus opponent sums of s(p, h) and off-role flags on the drafter state as of 2026-06-30 (fixed before the window), the actual player-hero cells. e = r - P. All in WP points. Team support: min3 / PMI of the real team on paper 1's corpus (p1) and on the lobby-window corpus (win, 2026-05-23..06-30; the judge window is not in it). 'slope_P' = slope of r on P within the bin (1 = the personal term is right on average; below 1 = over-trusted).
residual.unknown_players: players outside the tournament-window state set (60,335 players) get s = 0 and no off-role flag, i.e. no personal term; 'all_games' uses every game this way, 'all_known' only games with all ten players in the state set
